$about: Sources for style notes that do not come from Wikipedia (src/style.py). A place's entry in regions/style/<country>.json lists them under ref. EU specifications are the producers' own official descriptions, filed with the EU register (eAmbrosia) or the national authority; the rest are national wine bodies, a GI register and wine education writing. Cached copies are in data/cache/eu-spec and data/cache/style-web.
